programs.name: Standard 2 Step
programs.profit_split: 80%; 90% with an add-on bought at checkout
programs.payout_frequency: every 10 business days; first payout 10 business days after the first trade on the funded account
programs.payout_rules_note: Minimum $20 profit (before split). At least 3 profitable days of 0.5%+ are needed in each phase AND in each funded payout cycle. Challenge fee refunded after the third reward. Payout processed after KYC.
programs.notes: Targets: Phase 1 8% ($4,000), Phase 2 5% ($2,500). min_trading_days = 3 profitable days of at least 0.5% each. Daily loss 4%, calculated from the higher of balance or equity at 00:00 UTC (so the dollar limit can be above $2,000). Pricing page shows $198 with code ETERNAL (10% off) vs $220 list. Leverage 1:75 forex, 1:20 commodities/metals/indices, 1:2 digital ETFs.

programs.name: Standard 1 Step
programs.drawdown_type: intraday trailing on equity (5%; follows highest running equity including unrealized profit; no lock level stated)
programs.profit_split: 80%; 90% with an add-on bought at checkout
programs.payout_frequency: every 10 business days; first payout 10 business days after the first trade on the funded account
programs.payout_rules_note: Minimum $20 profit (before split). Challenge fee refunded after the third reward. Payout processed after KYC.
programs.notes: Target 8% ($4,000). No minimum trading days ('You may pass the challenge in a day'). Daily loss 3% from the higher of balance or equity at 00:00 UTC. Pricing page shows $153 with code ETERNAL vs $170 list.

programs.notes: Target 3% ($1,500) in each of the three phases. No minimum trading days. Daily loss 2% from the higher of balance or equity at 00:00 UTC. Pricing page shows $171 with code ETERNAL vs $190 list.

news_trading: Restricted: on Standard 1/2/3 Step, no opening or closing trades on affected instruments from 2 minutes before to 2 minutes after Forex Factory 'Red Folder' releases (a hard breach in the challenge); positions opened earlier may be held. 2 Step Omo: unrestricted in evaluation, funded profit per news event capped at 0.5% of balance. Instant, Instant Mini, BNPL and Prediction Markets: no news restriction
ea_bots_allowed: Not allowed: 'EAs and automated trading are prohibited across all Maven platforms. All trades must be executed manually.' (the T&Cs elsewhere mention prior approval for automated trading, which conflicts)
copy_trading: Restricted: only copying your own trades between your own accounts; copying another person breaches both accounts
overnight_weekend_holding: Allowed: positions may be held overnight and over the weekend
restricted_countries_note: Serbia: NO, not on Maven's restricted list. Restricted (25): Afghanistan, Belarus, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of the Congo, Cuba, Eritrea, Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Guyana, Haiti, Iran, Mali, North Korea, Russia, Saint Lucia, Sierra Leone, Somalia, South Sudan, Sudan, Ukraine, Vanuatu, Venezuela, Yemen. US and Canada are not on the list, but MetaTrader is not available there (Match Trader only). List on https://maventrading.com/terms-and-conditions and https://maventrading.com/faqs
payout_methods: Direct bank transfer (Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana only)

current_public_promo.applies_to: Challenges, per the banner on Maven's site

affiliate_program.commission: Silver (0-9 referrals) 5%, Gold (10-49) 7.5%, Platinum (50-99) 10%, Diamond (100+) 12.5% (must stay active); sub-affiliate bonus +2% level 2, +1% level 3
affiliate_program.notes: Application reviewed; requires 500+ social followers or a website with measurable traffic. Paid monthly once 10 referrals or $200 in sales is reached; KYC before first payout. The affiliate page shows the same 25-country restricted list; Serbia is not on it, but Maven does not explicitly state that Serbian residents can join. Sign-up at affiliates.maventrading.com/signup/.

pros: Low entry prices: 50K Standard 2 Step $220 list ($198 with the published ETERNAL code); sizes from $2K
Static 8% max loss on the 2 Step and no consistency rule on Standard plans
Overnight and weekend holding allowed on all plans
Several payout routes (USDT, USDC, Rise Pay) with a $20 minimum
cons: Trustpilot rating is withheld for a guidelines breach, with fake reviews removed (seen 2026-10-19)
T&Cs require traders not to 'defame' Maven on social media and review sites, with account termination as the stated consequence
EAs/bots are prohibited; news trading is restricted ±2 minutes on Standard plans
Fee is refunded only after the third reward; 1 Step uses an equity-based trailing max loss with no stated lock
Funded accounts merge to at most $200,000 combined; no scaling plan or live-capital route published
best_for: Low-budget forex/CFD traders who trade manually and want small, cheap static-drawdown 2-step or 3-step evaluations with weekend holding.
